title: PayGateway release event — deploy hash def456
description: Deployment event recorded for PayGateway service. Release hash: def456. Deployment completed at 10:30 UTC. This is the root deployment event for the def456 release of PayGateway. All child failure tickets referencing release_hash def456 should be grouped under this event for rollback evaluation.

title: PayGateway checkout broken — def456 deployment
description: The PayGateway checkout flow is broken following the def456 deployment at 10:30 UTC. Users cannot complete payments and the checkout endpoint is returning HTTP 503. Multiple e-commerce teams have escalated. The failure is directly attributed to the def456 release of PayGateway.

title: PayGateway 502 errors post def456 release
description: PayGateway is returning HTTP 502 errors on all payment processing endpoints since the def456 release went live at 10:30 UTC. Transaction processing is completely halted. SRE confirmed this regression is caused by the def456 deployment. Rollback candidate for release_hash def456.

title: PayGateway issue — release_hash ghi789
description: A configuration issue was discovered in an earlier PayGateway deployment identified by release_hash ghi789. This is a completely different deployment from the current def456 release. The ghi789 issue involves a legacy routing rule that conflicts with new infrastructure. Do not group this with def456 child failures.

title: PayGateway new feature request — recurring payments UI
description: Feature request from the billing team to add a recurring payments management interface to PayGateway. No relation to any deployment event or release hash. This is a product backlog item for future sprint planning. Not an incident.
